annotations.title: Look up a charity's legal name and tax ID

description: Find a U.S. charity's exact legal name, EIN (federal tax ID), city and state, and 501(c)(3) status from IRS filings (via ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer), with ready-to-use bequest and beneficiary-form wording. Helpful before a specific charity is named in a will or on a beneficiary form, because many charities have similar names. Search by name (optionally with a state), then look up the chosen organization by EIN. Churches and very small charities may not appear because they don't file Form 990.

ein.description: Federal tax ID (EIN), e.g. 13-1788491. Returns that organization's details and wording.

query.description: Charity name to search for, e.g. "St. Jude Children's Research Hospital".

state.description: Optional two-letter state code to narrow a name search.
